overview: This House resolution assigns Representative Beyer to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, which oversees federal science agencies such as NASA and the National Science Foundation as well as research policy. Committee assignments decide which members work on which subjects, and the House formally approves them through short resolutions like this one. It does not change any law. The House agreed to it on December 17, 2025.
for: Supporters say routine resolutions like this keep committees fully staffed so the House can do its work.
against: Critics say there is little to object to; the resolution is a procedural step that does not change any law or policy.
